number.description: Pull request number within its repository.

state.description: "open" or "closed". A draft is "open"; merged and closed pull requests are both "closed".

draft.description: Whether the pull request is still a draft.

merged.description: Whether the pull request has been merged.

head.description: The source side of the pull request - what is being merged in.

base.description: The target side of the pull request — what it merges into.

author.description: The principal that opened the pull request.

createdAt.description: When the pull request was opened.

updatedAt.description: When the pull request was last updated.

closedAt.description: When the pull request was closed or merged; unset while open.

mergedAt.description: When the pull request was merged; unset unless merged.

mergeCommitSha.description:
SHA of the commit the merge wrote to the base branch; set once merged,
 unset before. The pre-merge preview is the `pull/<number>/merge` ref
 (see GetGitRef), a different commit.

additions.description: Lines added by the pull request's latest version.

deletions.description: Lines deleted by the pull request's latest version.

changedFiles.description: Files changed by the pull request's latest version.

labels.description:
Labels currently assigned to this pull request, sorted by name. Empty when
 none are assigned. A pull request can have at most 100 labels.

stack.description: Stack membership. Unset when the pull request is not part of a stack.

color.description: Six-character hex color without a leading `#`.

OriginActor.description: A user, app, or service account that performed an externally visible action.

displayName.description:
The app's registered display name, never empty when present. Omitted on
 payloads whose app could not be resolved and on the first-party Cursor
 facade actor.

Human-readable display name: the account's first and last name, each
 trimmed, joined with a space — exactly the name the product UI renders.
 Omitted when the account has no name; never synthesized from the email,
 the id, or any other field. May also be absent on webhook payloads whose
 actor could not be resolved.

handle.description:
The user's claimed profile handle (the identity behind cursor.com
 /@handle), without the @ prefix. Present only while the user's profile
 is publicly visible; omitted for users without a claimed handle and for
 non-public profiles.

slug.description: Unique URL-friendly name of the owner.

id.description: Unique ID of the owner namespace.

ref.description: The ref this side points at, as Origin records it.

sha.description:
Tip commit SHA of this side at the change's latest version. For `base`
 this is the version's `base_sha`, which can lag the branch's current tip
 (see `PullRequestVersion`).

PullRequestRef.description: One side (head or base) of a change.

repository.description: Repository reference for this pull request.

PullRequestReference.description: Stable identity and display coordinates for an Origin pull request.

id.description:
Stable stack identifier. Pass it as `stack_id` to `ListPullRequests` to
 list the stack's members.

parentPullRequest.description:
The pull request this one is stacked on. Unset for the root of the stack.
 A merged parent stays referenced until the child is retargeted or
 re-parented.

PullRequestStackMembership.description:
Membership of a pull request in a stack: a chain of dependent pull requests
 in one repository, each stacked on the one it builds upon.

number.description: Monotonic version number within the change (1-based).

headSha.description: Head commit SHA for this version.

baseSha.description:
Base commit SHA this version is diffed against: the base branch tip as
 resolved when the version was recorded. It can lag the branch's current
 tip until the next head push or retarget.

PullRequestVersion.description:
A numbered revision of a change. A new version is recorded when the pull
 request's head is pushed or when it is retargeted to another base, each
 with its own head/base SHAs and diff stats. The base branch advancing on
 its own records nothing.

RepositoryReference.description: Stable identity and display coordinates for a repository.
